_about: RADAR golden sample (spec 17.1): hand-written, fictional job postings (no real companies, people or contact data; URLs use example domains). Labels are written from the posting TEXT only, never from RADAR's output. Conventions: role_match = the title names a target role (primary, secondary or fallback family); seniority = the level word in the title (Staff/Teamleiter = lead, II/Tier 2/Medior/Mid-level = mid); visa_status from the posting alone (offered = confirmed; refused or right-to-work required = not_offered; relocation-only or hedged = likely; both = conflicting; nothing = unknown); remote_class from the point of view of a candidate in India (UTC+5:30): on-site/hybrid = not_remote; salary as written (currency, period, amounts; a single figure labels only min); language: a non-English language required = local_required, English working language or an English posting without a statement = english_ok, a local-language posting without a statement = unclear; experience_min_years only when the posting states a minimum (a vague "several years" / "mehrjährige" reads as 2, more than one year). An absent label = not labelled.

samples.notes: Sponsorship + Blue Card stated explicitly; hybrid Berlin; annual EUR range.
